faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Willoughby Elementary (0.6 km east), Peter Ewart Middle School (0.7 km west) and R E Mountain Secondary (0.8 km south-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Willoughby Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is des Voyageurs, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is R E Mountain Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (2.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Alex Hope Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Willoughby Elementary (0.6 km east), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.9 km east), Josette Dandurand Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Lynn Fripps Elementary (1.3 km north-east), R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.7 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Willoughby Elementary, 0.6 km east of Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary.
